title: Hound of Ill Omen
html:
Hound of Ill Omen is a Shadow Magic sorcerer class action which allows them to summon  Nimbus, a shadow mastiff.

Description

Summon forth a creature of darkness.

Properties

Cost
 Bonus Action +  3 Sorcery Points
Details
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Recharge: Short rest

 Ominous Bite ()
Bite a target and possibly place an  Omen on them.
 Umbral Tangle ()
Trap your enemies in shadowy vines.
 Splinter Shadow ()
When you are attacked by a melee attack that does not deal Radiant damage, splinter off a piece of yourself to spawn a new version from the shadows.

Under special circumstances only:

 Right Behind You ()
Materialise next to your summoner's victim.

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 6: Shadow Magic

Notes

  • Although it is not specified anywhere, Nimbus can see in magical darkness. This means he does not suffer from  Blindness and attacks with advantage when fighting in the caster's  Darkness clouds.

Bugs

  • The CharacterStats for this summoned creature does not correctly have the proper DifficultyStatuses set, and as a result the creature loses 30% HP from the Explorer difficulty modifier as if it were a hostile NPC.
